content: 15-second continuous single take. Use @image1 for the woman and @image2 for the man; preserve both faces, bodies, hats and costumes exactly. In a warm Belle Époque French ballroom, they perform a graceful French quadrille and waltz: joined-hand side steps, a smooth partnered circle, one controlled underarm turn for the woman, then an elegant final pose. The camera completes one smooth clockwise 360° orbit around them, keeping both full bodies and feet visible. Painterly 2D animation matching the references, natural dress movement and gentle accordion music. No cuts, zooms, extra people, identity swaps, costume changes, modern moves or exaggerated can-can kicks.

La cámara completa una órbita suave de 360° en sentido horario alrededor de ellos, manteniendo visibles ambos cuerpos completos y los pies. Animación 2D pictórica que coincide con las referencias, movimiento natural de la ropa y música suave de acordeón. Sin cortes, zooms, personas extra, intercambios de identidad, cambios de vestuario, movimientos modernos ni patadas exageradas de can-can.
